Internal helper: wrap a bare column for the vector-input path

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_vector_frame.Rd

Builds the one-column data frame that jdesc(), jfreq() and jscreen() analyze when given a bare column, as in jdesc(community$Age), plus the names their messages use: the column as typed, the variable name (the part after the last dollar sign), and the frame it came from when typed as frame dollar column – MyData, the placeholder frame, otherwise. A column of a data frame (the resolver's first_arg_frame, Session 324) takes both names from that frame, so d[["Age"]] reads as Age from d, and is marked in_frame for .jst_vector_recurse().

Usage

.jst_vector_frame(arg1)

Arguments

arg1

The .jst_resolve_first_arg() result, mode vector_input.

Value

A list with frame, typed, var, frame_nm and in_frame.
